items.titleZh: 红牛引擎升级决定在即，意大利大奖赛前将揭晓
items.summaryZh: FIA预计本周内公布对F1动力单元制造商第二轮ADUO分析结果，红牛将在意大利大奖赛前得知其引擎能否在赛季末前进行升级。

items.originalTitle: 红牛引擎升级决定在即，赛季末前能否升级成焦点
items.summaryEn: The FIA is expected to announce this week the findings of its second round of ADUO analysis, and Red Bull will learn before the Italian Grand Prix whether its F1 engine can be upgraded before the end of the season.
detailZh: 红牛车队将在意大利大奖赛前得知，自己是否有机会在赛季末尾之前获得F1发动机升级的机会。
国际汽联（FIA）预计最早将于本周公布其对F1动力单元制造商性能的第二轮分析结果，该分析涉及额外研发与升级机会（ADUO）的相关规则。
今年早些时候，红牛曾措手不及，因为国际汽联在涵盖澳大利亚至加拿大大奖赛的第一轮ADUO审查中认定其为标杆发动机。
红牛被认定比其他所有制造商领先超过2%，这意味着它是唯一一家不被允许额外台架研发时间、研发支出以及推出新规格发动机的制造商。
车队方面不认同国际汽联（FIA）的调查结论，并要求该管理机构再次核查其数据以确保无误——随后进行了一次复核。
该复核的结果尚未公开发布，但据了解，没有任何证据能够改变国际汽联的看法。
在国际汽联的复核工作进行的同时，第二个ADUO时段也已结束。该时段从摩纳哥大奖赛持续到匈牙利大奖赛。
而且，根据与制造商达成的协议，国际汽联必须在一定时间窗口内将其调查结果通知制造商，以便为引入新的认证规格留出可能性。
据了解，公布第二次测量结果的截止日期在下周意大利大奖赛之前到期，因此有关这些发现的新闻，以及对其首个裁决进行审查的结果，应该很快就会公布。
第二个ADUO期间的结果对红牛赛季剩余阶段的计划至关重要，因为它将决定进入冬季的升级机会。
如果对红牛在摩纳哥至匈牙利期间表现的分析认定其落后于任何对手超过2%，那么这将为其获得开发机会打开大门——这可能使其在年底之前引入一次升级。
然而，如果再次认定其处于领先地位，甚至与最接近的对手梅赛德斯持平或在2%的差距之内，那么它获得任何额外开发机会的大门将会关闭。
如果红牛再次无能为力，那么2026年将剩下最后一次机会。
第三个ADUO时期从荷兰大奖赛持续到美国大奖赛，这将是各车队在2027赛季前的局面重置之前，在赛季中获得额外工作的最后一个窗口期。
这套系统已被证明存在争议，因为尽管梅赛德斯被普遍认为拥有最好的动力单元，但排名并非基于整体表现。
相反，这些排名只考虑了动力总成中的内燃机部分——而据了解，红牛在这一方面非常具有竞争力。
在夏休期前，国际汽联（FIA）单座赛车事务总监Nikolas Tombazis表示，未来或许可以商定一种新的测量方式——因为他认为管理机构在最初的分析中是对的。
"在我看来，我们的测量已被证明是非常准确的，"他说。
"话虽如此，一切都顺利吗？不，因为显然人们并不满意等等。那么我们是否需要考虑未来的改进？是的，我会这么说。"
不过，Tombazis淡化了这样一种说法：即红牛的对手们在获得ADUO之后，会现在钻系统的空子，放缓研发，让红牛永远无法提升而陷入困境。
这部分说法有一定道理，因为ADUO规则并不能给其他人提供任何保持落后的好处，因为收益在赛季中是不可累积的——所以一旦你获得了一次额外的开发机会，本赛季就到此为止了。
“我认为你一直待在下面并不合适，只是为了不断获得更多机会，”他说。“如果机会最终不是为了让你登上顶峰，那机会的意义何在？”
“我认为这个系统正按设计初衷运作。我确实认为它存在一些弱点，我们将来需要解决，这是肯定的，以让它更省时、更少争议。我们确实需要在未来采取一些措施来改进它。”
detailEn: Red Bull is set to find out before the Italian Grand Prix whether there will be any scope for it to get the opportunity for Formula 1 engine upgrades before the tail-end of the year.

The FIA is expected to announce as early as this week the findings of its second round of analysis of the performance of F1's power unit manufacturers in relation to the rules surrounding Additional Development and Upgrade Opportunities (ADUO).
Earlier this year, Red Bull was caught by surprise after the FIA deemed it to be the benchmark engine during the first round of ADUO auditing that covered the Australian to Canadian Grands Prix.

Red Bull was deemed to be more than 2% ahead of every other manufacturer, which meant it was the only one that would not be allowed extra dyno development time, spending, nor the ability to introduce a new specification.
It did not agree with the FIA's findings and requested the governing body check its data once again to be sure - with a review subsequently taking place.
The outcome of that review has not been released in public yet, but it is understood there was no evidence of anything that changed the FIA's opinion.
While work on the FIA review has been ongoing, the second ADUO period also concluded. That ran from the Monaco GP to the Hungarian GP.

And, under the agreement with manufacturers, the FIA has to notify them within a certain window of the outcome of its findings to ensure the door is open for the introduction of new homologation specifications.

It is understood that the deadline for announcing the result of the second measurement expires before the Italian GP next week, so news of these findings, as well as the outcome of its review into the first verdict, should be imminent.
The outcome of the second ADUO period is critical to Red Bull's plans for the remainder of the campaign because it will dictate upgrade opportunities into the winter.

If analysis of Red Bull's performance over the Monaco-Hungary period deems it to be more than 2% behind any of its rivals, then that will open the door for it to be granted development opportunities - which could allow it to introduce an upgrade before the end of the year.
If, however, it is once again deemed to be ahead, or even on equal terms or within 2% of closest rival Mercedes, then the door will be shut for it to have any extra development chances.
If Red Bull's hands are tied once again then there will be one final opportunity left in 2026.
The third ADUO period runs from the Dutch GP to the United States GP, and will be the last window for teams to get extra work in-season before things reset ahead of the 2027 campaign.
The system has proved to be controversial because while Mercedes is widely viewed to have the best power unit, the rankings are not based on overall performance.
Instead, they only take into account the internal combustion engine element of the package - where Red Bull is understood to be very competitive.

Speaking before the summer break, the FIA's single-seater director Nikolas Tombazis suggested that perhaps a new way of measuring things in the future could be agreed - as he reckoned the governing body had got it right with its initial analysis.
"Our measurement, in my opinion, has proven to be very accurate," he said.
"With that said, has everything worked fine? No, because obviously people are not happy and so on. So do we need to think about improvements in the future? Yes, I would say so."

Tombazis has played down suggestions, however, that Red Bull's rivals, having earned ADUO, would now game the system to hold back on developments and leave Red Bull trapped by never being able to improve.

This is partly true because ADUO rules do not offer any benefit for others to remain adrift as the gains are not cumulative during the season - so once you are granted extra development once that is it for the season.

"I don't think it would be convenient for you to always be below, just to sort of keep getting more opportunities," he said. "What's the point of opportunities if it isn't ultimately for you to be on top?

"I think the system is working as it was designed. I do think there are some weaknesses that we need to address in the future, for sure, to make it less time-consuming, less controversial. We do need to make some steps to improve it in the future."

keyPointsEn: The FIA audit concerns the rules around Additional Development and Upgrade Opportunities (ADUO).
The first ADUO audit covered the Australian to Canadian Grands Prix, and Red Bull was surprisingly deemed the benchmark engine.

items.titleZh: 罗斯伯格：维斯塔潘幸运避免荷兰大奖赛连环撞车
items.summaryZh: 2016年F1世界冠军尼科·罗斯伯格表示，马克斯·维斯塔潘在荷兰大奖赛首圈撞车中很幸运，没有引发多车连环相撞。维斯塔潘在湿滑条件下于主场首圈发生严重撞车，比赛出示红旗，他的比赛提前结束。

items.originalTitle: 尼科·罗斯伯格：维斯塔潘幸运避免荷兰大奖赛连环撞车
items.summaryEn: 2016 Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg said Max Verstappen was fortunate not to trigger a multi-car pile-up in his opening-lap crash at the Dutch Grand Prix. Verstappen crashed heavily on the first lap in damp conditions, bringing out the red flag and ending his race early.
detailZh: 尼科·罗斯伯格表示，马克斯·维斯塔潘在荷兰大奖赛上“幸运地”躲过了连环撞车。
尼科·罗斯伯格说，马克斯·维斯塔潘在荷兰大奖赛第一圈撞车退赛后，很幸运没有引发多车连环相撞的大事故。
2016年一级方程式冠军尼科·罗斯伯格认为，红牛车手马克斯·维斯塔潘在荷兰大奖赛第一圈撞车时很幸运，没有引发多车连环相撞。
这位四届冠军在潮湿条件下于家乡大奖赛的第一圈发生严重撞车，比赛因此出示红旗，他早早结束了比赛。幸运的是，没有其他车手被卷入这起事故，不过奥迪车队的加布里埃尔·博托莱托在维斯塔潘身后因一起无关事故发生打滑，但得以继续比赛。
赛后罗斯伯格在接受天空体育 F1采访时解释道："大家都在这里为他加油助威，结果却这么早就退出了比赛，但这就是当时的条件所致。
"在这种条件下驾驶实在太难了，尤其是在光头胎上很难判断抓地力的极限，所以即使是当今最伟大的车手、这里最伟大的车手，也发生了严重撞车。
"正如Max所说，我们真的很幸运，因为如果他在赛道中央打转，而整个车群以全速驶来，那可能会造成多车相撞的大规模事故，赛车会直接撞上他。那可能会导致非常糟糕的结果，所以他还算是有点运气。
由于这次撞车，Verstappen在自己的主场大奖赛周末仅带着3个积分离开，这些积分来自冲刺赛第六名的成绩。这位荷兰车手目前在车手积分榜上以112分排名第六，落后领跑积分榜的安东内利 130分。
在比赛中提前退赛后，维斯塔潘（Verstappen）在接受天空体育 F1采访时确认，他正在寻求最大限度地发挥赛车的一切潜力，但从现实来看，他驾驶的是围场里第四快的赛车。
“我是说，如果看平均水平的话，整个赛季我们都是第四快，”他说。“所以，我认为这个周末真的凸显了这一点，我们确实落后了一点。我们想要更接近一些。也许在蒙扎可以，但我不知道。”
“赛季即将接近尾声。你也必须展望明年。我认为赛车上有一些我们正在研究的东西，只能等到明年才能改变，才能真正找到更多的性能。”
“所以，我们将尽力用这辆赛车发挥出一切潜力。但赛季末不会是最顺利的。但我们会尽力做到最好。”
detailEn: Max Verstappen was "lucky" to avoid Dutch GP pile-up, says Nico Rosberg
Nico Rosberg says Max Verstappen was fortunate to avoid a major multi-car crash after crashing out on the opening lap of the Dutch GP
2016 Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg argued that Red Bull driver Max Verstappen was lucky to avoid triggering a multi-car pile-up during his opening-lap crash at the Dutch Grand Prix.

The four-time champion suffered a violent crash on the first lap of his home grand prix in damp conditions, which triggered the red flag and ended his race early. Luckily, no other driver was caught up in the crash, although Audi's Gabriel Bortoleto spun behind Verstappen in an unrelated incident and  managed to continue.
Speaking on Sky Sports F1 following the race, Rosberg explained: "Everybody's here cheering him on and then to go out of the race so early on like that, but it was the conditions.

"It's just so incredibly hard in those conditions and especially on the slick tyre to judge the limit of the grip there, and so even the greatest of the moment, the greatest driver here, had a big crash.

"And as Max said, we really got lucky there because if he spins and remains in the middle of the track and you have the whole pack coming at full speed, that could be a multi-car massive shunt with people driving right into him. That could have been a really bad outcome, so he even got a bit lucky there."

As a result of the crash, Verstappen walked away from his home race weekend with just three points, which he collected from a sixth-place finish in the sprint race. The Dutchman currently sits sixth in the drivers' standings with 112 points, 130 points behind championship leader Kimi Antonelli.

While speaking to Sky Sports F1 after his early exit from the race, Verstappen confirmed that he is looking to maximise everything he can from the car but that, realistically, he is in the fourth-fastest car on the grid.

"I mean, if you look at the average, the whole season we have been fourth fastest," he said. "So, I think this weekend really highlighted that, so we're definitely a little bit behind. We want to be closer. Maybe Monza we are, but I don't know.

"We're getting towards the end of the season. You also have to look at next year. I think there are a few things in the car that we are looking at that can only be changed next year to really find a lot more performance.
"So, we will just try to maximise everything we can with this car. But it's not going to be the most straightforward end to the season. But we'll try to do the best we can."

items.summaryZh: 兰多·诺里斯表示，相比2025年夺冠赛季，他今年在F1赛场内外的表现都更加出色。这位迈凯伦卫冕世界冠军刚在匈牙利和赞德福特连续两站拿下杆位和胜利。

items.originalTitle: 兰多·诺里斯：我正在消除F1弱点，且弱点已不多
items.summaryEn: Lando Norris says he is performing better both on and off the track in F1 this year compared to his title-winning 2025 campaign. The reigning world champion just took pole and victory in back-to-back rounds at Hungary and Zandvoort for McLaren.
detailZh: 诺里斯：我正在消除我在F1中的弱点，而且我的弱点已经不多了
诺里斯认为，与夺冠的赛季相比，他在2026年F1赛季的赛道内外都成长为了一名更出色的车手
诺里斯认为，与夺冠的2025赛季相比，他今年在F1中的赛道内外表现都更好，此前他刚在迈凯伦车队取得了连续两场胜利。
这位现任F1世界冠军在最近两站匈牙利和赞德福特比赛中都拿到了杆位和胜利，为艰难的卫冕之路注入了新的活力，而迈凯伦在新规则时代的开局比较缓慢。
随着诺里斯目前位列积分榜第四，仍落后领跑者安东内利 83分，关于冠军争夺的讨论到目前为止已被平息，但从他个人的表现水平来看，这位英国车手感觉自己比夺冠赛季时状态更好。
“去年下半年我的驾驶水平很高。很难说（我是否处于自己的最高水平），但我确实认为今年的车在某些方面更难驾驭，”诺里斯说。“我想你可以看到这一点，因为今年队友之间的差距往往比去年更大，我可以这么说。但我确实相信是这样的。
“我确实相信自己能够更好地理解各种情况，以更好的方式理解赛车。虽然驾驶它仍然很糟糕，但我在理解这一点、把这些信息传达给我的车队、解决问题方面做得更好了。
“所以，这不仅仅是我在赛道上驾驶得更好。我确实在消除自己在赛道上的弱点，虽然我的弱点不多，但这也是我在赛道外的工作方式。对我来说，从昨天到今天就是一个完美的例子，展示我们连夜投入的工作如何改变了我们的比赛，并给了我赢得比赛的机会。
“所以，我们在赛道之外付出的努力无疑是其中非常重要的一部分。”
诺里斯说，在赞德沃特的冲刺赛和大奖赛之间通宵进行的工作，是他在赛道之外进步的一个很好的例子。在周六冲刺赛中滑落到第三名后，他与迈凯伦的工程师们一起专注于寻找提升的空间。
当被问及他的第13个大奖赛冠军在心中排在什么位置时，诺里斯回答道：“相当高，仅仅从很多方面来说这都是一场经过激烈拼搏才拿下的胜利。比这更重要的是从昨天到今天的转变。
“我昨天挺失望的。看到我们在冲刺赛中挣扎成那样，某种程度上浇灭了我心中的一把火。我知道那只是冲刺赛，但每一个积分都很重要，而我们真的没有速度。我缺少那种能让我在车里焕发活力的东西。
“昨晚我们非常非常努力地工作。我花了很多时间和我的工程师们一起，去理解我们今天能做得更好的地方，如何推进更多、更省轮胎，如何把每件事都做得比之前更好、比其他所有人都好。而且我确实相信我今天做到了。”
“所以除了起步之外，这场比赛有点混合的状态，因为第一段开始的时候相当糟糕，有点让我想起昨天的情况。但我们换上硬胎之后，一切都活跃起来，比赛才真正重新回到我手中。”
detailEn: Lando Norris: I’m eliminating my F1 weaknesses, and I don’t have so many
Norris feels he has developed into a better driver both on and off of the track during the 2026 F1 season compared to his title-winning year
Lando Norris feels he is performing better both on and off the track in Formula 1 this year compared to his title-winning 2025 campaign, fresh off back-to-back wins for McLaren.

The reigning F1 world champion has taken pole and victory in the last two rounds in Hungary and Zandvoort to breathe fresh life into a difficult title defence, as McLaren made a slow start to the new regulations era.

With Norris fourth in the standings and still 83 points behind leader Kimi Antonelli, talk of a title fight has been quelled so far, but from his personal performance levels the British driver feels he’s operating better than during his title-winning season.

“I was driving at a high level the second half of last year. It’s tough to say [if I’m driving at my highest level], but I do think it’s a trickier car to drive this year in some ways,” Norris said. “I think you can see that because the gaps between team-mates are often bigger this year, I would say, than it was last year. But I do believe so.

“I do believe I’m able to understand situations better, to understand the car in a better way. It’s still just horrible to drive, but I’m doing a better job at just understanding this, relaying this to my team, figuring stuff out.

“So, it’s not just I’m driving better on track. I’m certainly eliminating my weaknesses on track, and I don’t have so many, but it’s also how I work off the track. And for me, yesterday to today is a perfect example of [how] the work we put in overnight transformed our race and gave me the opportunity to win.
“So, the work we put in away from the track is certainly a huge part of that.”

Norris said overnight work between the sprint race and grand prix in Zandvoort was a good example of his improvements off the track, having focused with his McLaren engineers to find gains after he drifted to third place in the Saturday sprint race.
When asked where he ranks his 13th grand prix victory, Norris replied: “Pretty high just from a point of very well fought in many ways. More than that is the turnaround from yesterday to today.

“I was pretty disappointed yesterday. It kind of took a little bit of the fire out of me, seeing how much we struggled in the sprint. I know it’s just a sprint, but every point matters and we just really didn’t have the pace. I didn’t have that something that gave me life inside the car.

“Last night we worked very, very hard. I spent a lot of time with my engineers to kind of understand what we could do better today, how to push more, save the tyres more, how to do everything in a better way than I’ve done and better than everyone else. And I certainly believe I did that today.

“So apart from the start, it was a little bit of a mix of races because the beginning in the first stint was pretty bad and kind of reminded me of yesterday. But we put the hard tyres on and things came alive and the race really started to come back to me.”
keyPointsZh: 迈凯伦在新规则时代开局缓慢，使诺里斯的车手卫冕之路较为艰难
连续两站的杆位和胜利为艰难的卫冕注入了新活力
keyPointsEn: McLaren made a slow start to the new regulations era, making Norris's title defence difficult
Back-to-back pole positions and victories have breathed fresh life into a difficult title defence

items.titleZh: 皮亚斯特里困惑于与诺里斯的圈速差距
items.summaryZh: 奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里坦言不解为何难以发挥迈凯伦赛车性能，而队友兰多·诺里斯凭借大幅升级的MCL40连续两站杆位夺冠。

items.originalTitle: 奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里困惑于2026年F1中与兰多·诺里斯的圈速差距
items.summaryEn: Oscar Piastri is puzzled by his inability to maximise the McLaren package, while team-mate Lando Norris has won the last two grands prix from pole in a heavily upgraded MCL40.
detailZh: 奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里对2026赛季F1中与兰多·诺里斯的速度差距感到困惑
兰多·诺里斯驾驶迈凯伦赛车连续两场大奖赛从杆位发车并夺冠，而奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里则在速度上苦苦挣扎
奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里一直在苦苦思索，为什么相比队友兰多·诺里斯，自己难以充分发挥迈凯伦这套F1赛车的性能。
这位卫冕世界冠军凭借大幅升级的MCL40赛车，连续在布达佩斯和赞德沃特两场大奖赛从杆位发车并夺冠，而皮亚斯特里则遭遇了一次退赛（未完成比赛），并只获得第六名。
这让诺里斯在车手积分榜上排名第四，领先排名第七的皮亚斯特里55分，而在今年的排位赛正面交锋（包括冲刺赛）中，皮亚斯特里还以4比13落后于他的队友。
所以这位澳大利亚车手显然只能屈居第二，自五月的迈阿密站以来他就没有登上过领奖台，而他上一次获胜还是在去年八月的赞德沃特——当时他看起来像是一位即将加冕的冠军。
“很遗憾，这不是第一次出现速度跟不上的情况了，”皮亚斯特里在周日表示。“兰多赢得比赛领先优势相当大，所以我认为赛车状态不错。
“过去两个周末赛车都很快。我觉得这两条赛道很适合这辆赛车。只是不知道为什么，我一直无法把速度发挥出来。”
但不应过分惊讶于皮亚斯特里在2026年的挣扎，因为在新的规则下空气下压力水平降低，他现在不得不应对一辆抓地力更低的赛车。
这位25岁的车手在低抓地力条件下的挣扎是出了名的，比如上个赛季末，皮亚斯特里的争冠势头就在巴库、新加坡和墨西哥城等赛道崩塌了。
所以他比大多数人不得不做出更多适应，尽管仍能偶尔看到他的潜力，比如在赞德沃特领跑冲刺排位赛（SQ2）和排位赛第一节（Q1），但其他车手已经在关键时刻找到了那种优势。
“在驾驶风格方面，肯定是有一些原因的，”当被问及本赛季他与诺里斯相比欠缺在哪里时，皮亚斯特里这样说道。
“我认为这个周末的排位赛我感觉自在多了，在第一节和第二节排位赛（Q1和Q2）表现不错，当然第三节（Q3）我没有完全发挥出来，但我确实在竞争行列之中。”
这位澳大利亚车手排位赛获得第四名，落后诺里斯0.142秒，分别落后梅赛德斯车队的拉塞尔和安东内利0.040秒和0.009秒。
“但在正赛里，情况就完全不一样了，”皮亚斯特里补充道。“所以，是的，我认为这就是最大的差别。”
周日的比赛中，皮亚斯特里在第三圈的七号弯超越拉塞尔升至第三位，但由于一次耗时5.4秒的缓慢进站（停站），在第19圈又跌回第四位。
从那时起，皮亚斯特里就一直苦于速度不足，法拉利车队的勒克莱尔和汉密尔顿也先后超越了他，最终他落后诺里斯32秒完赛。
当迈凯伦领队安德烈亚·斯特拉被要求解释皮亚斯特里的困境时，这位意大利人表示：“我认为这和任何心理层面的问题没有任何关系，这纯粹是技术问题。”
“实际上这个周末我们看到奥斯卡做出了有竞争力的单圈时间，我认为在正赛中有两个因素影响了奥斯卡。”
“其一，这也是车队的责任，就是当我们进站以防守拉塞尔的时候，实际上因为一次缓慢的进站停站，我们把位置丢给了拉塞尔，这要归咎于车队。”
奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里与安德烈亚·斯特拉在匈牙利
“那么这第二次使用硬胎的赛段，我们没能让这套轮胎进入工作状态。它们一直处于抓地力极低的状态，这种情况在第一次赛段中我们没有看到。
“所以有几件事我们需要改进。但我也想补充一点，我们现在所处的F1阶段，至少有三支车队的差距在0.1秒以内。
“只要任何环节没有做到最优，你就可能损失非常多的名次。所以如果你没有做到最优，现在你就只能排在第六位。
“从这个角度来说这是非常残酷的，所以我认为我们只需要和奥斯卡一起抓住所有机会继续努力，而我对本周末所看到的进步感到满意。”
菲律宾·克利伦和罗纳德·沃尔丁补充报道
detailEn: Oscar Piastri confused by pace deficit to Lando Norris in F1 2026
Lando Norris has won the last two grands prix from pole for McLaren, whereas Oscar Piastri is struggling for pace
Oscar Piastri is scratching his head as to why he’s struggled to maximise the McLaren Formula 1 package compared to team-mate Lando Norris.
The reigning world champion has won the last two grands prix - Budapest and Zandvoort - from pole thanks to a heavily-upgraded MCL40, while Piastri has suffered a DNF and finished sixth.
It has left Norris fourth in the standings and 55 points ahead of seventh-placed Piastri, who also trails his team-mate 13-4 in their qualifying head-to-head (sprint races included) this year.
So the Australian has certainly been second best and he is without a podium since Miami in May, while his last win came at Zandvoort last August - when he looked like a champion-in-waiting.
“Unfortunately it's not the first race where the pace just hasn't been there,” said Piastri on Sunday. “Lando has just won the race [by] quite a lot, so I think the car is in a good place.
“It's been quick the last two weekends. I think these two tracks suit the car well. It's just for whatever reason, I've not been able to get the pace out of it.”
But one shouldn’t be too surprised by Piastri’s struggles in 2026, because he is now having to contend with a lower-grip car due to downforce levels reducing under the new rules.
It is in low-grip conditions where the 25-year-old notoriously struggles, as Piastri’s title bid collapsed towards the end of last season at tracks like Baku, Singapore and Mexico City.
So he’s had to adapt more than most and although there’s still been glimpses of his potential, like topping SQ2 and Q1 at Zandvoort, others have found that edge for when it matters.
“In the driving style, there clearly must be something,” said Piastri, when asked where he lacks compared to Norris this season.
“I think in qualifying this weekend I felt much more comfortable and through Q1 and Q2, okay, Q3 I didn't quite maximise it, but I was there in the fight.”
The Australian qualified fourth, 0.142s off Norris and 0.040s and 0.009s behind Mercedes duo George Russell and Kimi Antonelli, respectively.
“In the race, the story just wasn't the same at all,” added Piastri. “So, yeah, I think that's the biggest difference.”
Sunday’s race saw Piastri overtake Russell at Turn 7 for third on lap three before dropping back to fourth on lap 19 due to a slow 5.4s pitstop.
From then on Piastri just struggled for pace as Ferrari duo Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton also overtook him and he eventually finished 32 seconds behind Norris.
When McLaren boss Andrea Stella was asked to explain Piastri’s woes, the Italian said: “I don't think it has anything to do with any psychological kind of opportunity - this is purely technical.
“This weekend actually we saw Oscar expressing competitive lap times and I think in the race there were two factors that affected Oscar.
“One was the fact, and this is a team responsibility, that when we pitted to cover Russell, actually we lost the position to Russell because of a slow pitstop and this is up to the team.
Oscar Piastri and Andrea Stella in Hungary
“Then this second stint on hard tyres, we were not able to switch these tyres on. They stayed permanently in a regime of very, very low grip, which we didn't see in the first stint.
“So there's a couple of things that we need to work on. But I would also add to this that we are in a phase of Formula 1 in which we have at least three teams that are within one tenth of a second.
“As soon as things are not optimised, then you may have a very significant positional loss. So if you're not optimised, now you are P6.
“It's very brutal from this point of view, so I think we just have to keep working with Oscar on all the opportunities and I'm happy with the improvements that I've seen during this weekend.”
Additional reporting by Filip Cleeren and Ronald Vording

detailZh: Netflix续订《Formula 1: Drive to Survive》第九季
Netflix已确认《Formula 1: Drive to Survive》将回归第九季
安东内利，梅赛德斯，《Drive to Survive》第八季
Netflix已正式确认，其幕后纪录片系列《Formula 1: Drive to Survive》（《极速求生》）将回归第九季，内容涵盖正在进行中的2026赛季。
这部纪录片剧集于2019年在该流媒体平台首播，让观众前所未有地深入围场，并得以了解车手们在赛道之外的个人生活。
制作该节目的进站 to 进站公司执行制片人詹姆斯·盖-里斯和保罗·马丁说：
我们非常高兴能制作这部标志性节目的第九季。今年我们将比以往任何时候都更深入地探索这项精彩运动的隐秘角落。

,"尽管该剧因采用创造性的剪辑手法来营造真人秀式的戏剧效果而受到一些批评，但这部系列赛对锦标赛人气提升的影响是不可否认的。它在扩大美国车迷群体、吸引更多年轻观众以及提高女性观众比例方面发挥了重要作用。","盖-里斯在2023年接受F1官网采访时谈到了这部纪录片剧集的影响。"说实话，我们为能参与其中感到无比自豪。能率先做出这样的东西也带来了极大的满足感，我认为这在某种程度上确实是第一部产生如此深远影响的主要深度探访节目——至少在英国范围内肯定是。
“我们都听过那些关于受众结构在变化、越来越年轻化的统计数据，如今对任何人、对任何大型组织来说，想要守住自己的阵地都很艰难，因为消费者的选择实在太多了。把如此庞大的新观众群体带进一项运动——这显然是理所当然应得的，只是需要有人把它打开——让人感到非常满足。”
“事实证明这并非偶然，事实证明它在（每个赛季）不断成长……这是一种真正的荣誉，我们热爱它。做这样一档节目非常困难，但我们热爱这个过程，热爱这个世界。希望它能长长久久地继续下去！”
这部纪录剧集的第九季将聚焦2026赛季的F1。
车迷们已经纷纷表达了对2027年播出这一季的期待。一位车迷在Netflix英国官方Instagram账号发布的公告下评论道：“阿斯顿·马丁那一集绝对会是电视上的神作。”
“期待《求生之路》（DTS）马拉松，”另一个人发帖说，而另一位车迷补充道：“好，我等不及看《求生之路》（DTS）了。我其实挺喜欢的。”
detailEn: Netflix renews "Formula 1: Drive to Survive" for season 9
Netflix has confirmed "Formula 1: Drive to Survive" will return for a ninth season
Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, Drive to Survive Season 8
Netflix has officially confirmed that its behind-the-scenes docuseries Formula 1: Drive to Survive will return for a ninth season, covering the ongoing 2026 season.
The docuseries, which premiered on the streaming service in 2019, has given viewers unprecedented access to the paddock and an insight into the drivers' personal lives beyond the track.

"We’re so excited to be making Season 9 of this iconic show," James Gay-Rees and Paul Martin, executive producers at Box to Box, which produces the show, said. "This year we’re going to go deeper than ever before into the hidden spaces of this fantastic sport."

While it has been met with some criticism for its creative editing to bring the drama of a reality television show, the impact the series has had on the popularity of the championship cannot be denied. It has been instrumental in the growth of the fanbase in the United States and in attracting a younger audience with a higher proportion of women to the racing series.

Gay-Rees spoke about the impact of the docuseries during an interview with F1.com in 2023. "Genuinely, we are enormously proud to be a part of it. There’s also a lot of satisfaction at being first with these things, and I think that it kind of does feel like the first main access show – certainly out of the UK anyway – that has had this profound effect.

"We’ve all had the statistics about the changing, younger demographic, and it’s tough out there for anybody, for any big organisation, to hold its ground given the amount of choices that are out there for the consumer. Bringing such a big new audience to a sport – which obviously was deserved, it just needed somebody to open it up – is massively satisfying.

"The fact that it wasn’t a fluke, the fact that it’s grown [with every season]… It’s a real honour and we love it. It’s a very difficult show to make, but we love the process, we love the world. Long may it continue!"
The ninth season of the docuseries will centre on the 2026 F1 season.

Fans have already shared their excitement about the 2027 release. "The Aston Martin episode will be Absolute Television," one fan commented on the announcement shared on the official Netflix UK Instagram account.
"Looking forward to the DTS marathon," someone else posted, while another fan added: "OK I can’t wait for DTS. I actually like it."

items.originalTitle: “请给我打电话！”——角田裕毅在荷兰大奖赛表现出色后俏皮地请求重返F1
items.summaryEn: Yuki Tsunoda finished 11th at Zandvoort and said he did everything he could to boost his chances of returning to the F1 grid, making a tongue-in-cheek appeal to teams for 2027.
detailZh: “请给我打电话吧！”——角田裕毅在荷兰大奖赛表现出色后，俏皮地为自己重返F1发出呼吁
角田裕毅表示，在赞德沃特获得第11名后，他已经竭尽所能提升自己重返F1发车区的机会。他半开玩笑地向各车队发出了2027赛季的请求
过去一周对角田裕毅来说真像坐过山车。小红牛CEO彼得·拜尔其实在上周五就已得知伊萨克·哈贾尔手腕受伤、可能会更换车手的消息，但据角田说，他直到周二才接到电话——当时他还在希腊的海滩上。
这位日本车手立即强调，自己的身体状态完全能够应付这场替补出场，不过能否适应2026年的赛车仍是一个重要的问号。没错，角田今年在模拟器里 充分 测试过红牛赛车——而不是小红牛的赛车——但真车毕竟是另一回事。
但恰恰在这个方面，赞德沃特的比赛周末进行得非常顺利。角田裕毅在整个周末都成功将圈速保持在与队友阿尔维德·林德布拉德接近的水平，两节排位赛均排在第12位，最终以第11名完赛，领先于林德布拉德。
"说实话，我觉得我的进步比预期更快。自从上一场阿布扎比大奖赛以来，八个月里我只开了四次车。在这样的情况下，我表现得相当不错，"角田裕毅在比赛结束后说道。
角田裕毅确实承认，从过去几年他已经习惯的地面效应赛车过渡到现在的赛车，是一个相当大的调整。
在赞德沃特这种对能量需求很高的赛道上，能量管理甚至都不是决定性因素，但这个调整过程仍然意义重大。
就在几天前他还在希腊的海滩上度假，角田裕毅却在荷兰大奖赛上给人留下了非常好的印象。
"我认为最具挑战性的部分几乎是一切——很多方面，比如学习能量输出、方向盘上的按键等等，所有流程都不一样。而且这场比赛因为轮胎衰减也很有挑战性，衰减的特性也非常不同，"他说。
"所以关键在于如何去适应，但说实话，车队给了我很大支持。他们让我能轻松地尽可能跑快。很遗憾我没有拿到积分，但我能接受。可以说，我一直和排名前八或前九的车手战斗到了最后几圈。"
"车队必须决定要不要我，但他们应该要我！"
显而易见的后续问题是，这对角田的未来意味着什么。在荷兰大奖赛之前，他就已经表示一级方程式仍然是计划 A，但他说自己不想再在 场边 上坐一年。
“我知道自己能做什么，而且我认为我已经向围场里的大多数人展示了我能做到什么。”他说。
“仅仅参加了一场比赛、几节各节练习与排位，我就能够接近积分区去争夺。说实话，我认为结果……显然，如果能拿到积分就更好了，但我认为我已经尽了全力。”
在小红牛的机会出现之前，如果一级方程式的大门没有打开，角田似乎主要考虑在 2027 年转战印地赛车（IndyCar）。但在赞德沃特，他至少证明了自己在当前复杂的规则下，仍然可以成为任何中游车队的一项资产。
角田裕毅的目标仍然是全职重返一级方程式，尽管印地赛车（IndyCar）可能是一个替代选择。他不想再在 场边 旁观一年——即在场边闲置一年。
"有这个机会肯定比没有任何机会要好，否则我就无法在这些规则下展示我能做到什么，"他说。
"剩下的就看我的经纪人和其他还没决定明年车手阵容的车队了，看他们想不想要我，但他们应该想要，"这位已经拥有112次一级方程式发车经历的车手笑着说。
当 Motorsport.赛车运动网站问他，在上个周末之后他全职重返一级方程式的机会是否有所增加时，角田裕毅停顿了很长时间。
七秒钟后，他抬起头笑了起来：“这问题挺狡猾的，对吧？”
又停顿了超过15秒，期间他询问小红牛的新闻官该如何回答这个问题，随后角田裕毅在离开时半开玩笑地向2027年的F1车队喊话：“请给我打电话吧！”
detailEn: "Call me, please!" – Yuki Tsunoda makes cheeky F1 return pitch after impressive Dutch GP

Yuki Tsunoda says that by finishing 11th at Zandvoort, he did everything he could to improve his chances of returning to the F1 grid. With a tongue-in-cheek remark, he makes an appeal to teams for 2027

The past week has been a real rollercoaster for Yuki Tsunoda. Racing Bulls CEO Peter Bayer had already been informed the previous Friday of Isack Hadjar’s wrist injury and a potential driver change, but according to Tsunoda, he only received the call on Tuesday – while he was still on a beach in Greece.

The Japanese driver immediately stressed that he was physically fully prepared for the stand-in appearance, although adapting to the 2026 machinery remained an important question mark. Yes, Tsunoda has extensively tested the Red Bull car – not the Racing Bulls – in the simulator this year, but the real thing is still different.

But in precisely that respect, the race weekend at Zandvoort went remarkably well. Tsunoda managed to stay close to team-mate Arvid Lindblad’s lap times throughout the weekend, qualified 12th in both qualifying sessions and eventually finished the race in 11th, ahead of Lindblad.

"Honestly, I think I was able to progress faster than I expected. I drove only four times out of eight months since my last race in Abu Dhabi. And with that, I did pretty well," Tsunoda said after the race.
Tsunoda did acknowledge that it had been quite an adjustment going from the ground-effect cars he had become accustomed to over the previous years to the current machinery.
At an energy-rich circuit like Zandvoort, energy management was not even the deciding factor, but the adjustment was still significant.
Just a few days after he was still on the beach in Greece, Tsunoda made a very good impression at the Dutch Grand Prix

"I think the most challenging part was pretty much everything – a lot of things, learning about deployment, buttons, everything, all procedures are different. And this race was also challenging because of tyre degradation, the degradation characteristic was also very different," he said.

"So it was all about how to adapt to that, but honestly, the team supported me a lot. They made it easy for me to drive as fast as possible. It's a shame that I didn't score points, but I take it. I was fighting against top eight or top nine until the last few laps, I would say."
"Teams have to decide if they want me or not, but they should!"

The obvious follow-up question is what this means for Tsunoda’s future. Ahead of the Dutch GP, he had already indicated that F1 remains plan A, but said that he does not want to spend another year on the sidelines.
"I know what I can do and I think I pretty much showed what I can do to most of the paddock," he said.

"With just one race, a couple of sessions, I was able to fight close to the points. Honestly, I think the outcome was... obviously, scoring points [would have been] better, but I think I did as much as I could."

Before the opportunity with Racing Bulls arose, Tsunoda appeared to be looking primarily towards IndyCar for 2027 if no door opened in F1. But at Zandvoort, he at least showed that he can still be an asset to any midfield team under the current, complex regulations.
A full-time F1 return remains Tsunoda’s goal, although IndyCar could be an alternative. He does not want to spend another year on the sidelines
"It's definitely better having this opportunity, rather than not having any opportunity, so not being able to show what I can do with these regulations," he said.
"The rest is up to my manager and other teams who have not decided yet about next year's line-up, if they want to have me or not, but they should," laughed the man with 112 F1 starts to his name.
When Motorsport.com asked him whether his chances of a full-time F1 return had increased after the past weekend, Tsunoda paused for a long time.
After seven seconds, he looked up and laughed: "That’s cheeky, huh?"

After another pause of more than 15 seconds, during which he asked the Racing Bulls press officer how best to answer the question, Tsunoda made a light-hearted appeal to F1 teams for 2027 as he walked away: "Call me, please!"

items.summaryZh: The 比赛的埃德·斯特劳根据荷兰大奖赛表现发布车手排名，冲刺赛赛制、赞德福特赛道布局与赛前降雨对全体车手构成考验。
items.originalTitle: 埃德·斯特劳评2026荷兰大奖赛F1车手排名
items.summaryEn: Edd Straw of The Race has published his driver rankings from the Dutch Grand Prix, where the sprint format, the Zandvoort layout and pre-race rain tested the entire Formula 1 field.
detailZh: 把冲刺赛周末的赛制、赞德沃特赛道的高要求，以及开赛前突如其来的降雨结合在一起——最后一届（就目前而言）荷兰大奖赛已经具备了对整个F1车手阵容进行真正考验的一切要素。
谁顺利通过了这场考验，谁的希望又被击得粉碎？以下是埃德·斯特劳对荷兰站的圆桌式车手排名。
冠军级别的会员还可以亲自尝试整理出自己的车手排名，埃德将在另一篇文章中对此作出回应！
这个排名是怎么运作的？每个大奖赛周末，22位车手将按表现从最好到最差依次排名。这将基于全方位的评判标准，从速度、比赛技巧，到稳定性，以及是否犯下关键错误。每位车手距离发挥出赛车最大性能潜力有多接近，将是一个重要的考量因素。
需要注意的是，这既反映了整个周末的综合表现——要认识到排位赛实际上相当于比赛的“第0圈”，是为正赛奠定基础的关键——同时也并不是对每位车手全面实力的排名。它只是关于车手在某个特定周末的表现如何。因此，这一排名会在每个周末之间出现明显波动。
由于11支车队（注：原文如此）在根本性能潜力上各不相同，加上“运气”（即车手无法控制的因素）也会影响周末的走向，这一排名也会与最终的总成绩有明显差异。
- 他在硬胎上惊人的速度是取胜的关键，而队友奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里却始终无法发挥出这种速度。
- 在缠斗中表现得极为犀利，当他和对方一同追赶较慢的刘易斯·汉密尔时，抓住了机会超越了基米·安东内利。
- 甚至是迈凯伦车手中最快的，即便与皮亚斯特里的最佳表现相比也是如此。
- 本有机会争夺冲刺赛杆位，但只做出了他自称"还不错的单圈"，最终以0.041秒之差落后于拉塞尔。
- 在冲刺赛中从第二滑落至第三，不过可以说明的是，在被超越之后他的节奏显示后轮退化确实是个问题。
- 红旗之后重新发车时失去领先位置，他认为是因为抓地力较低的杆位发车格让他的比赛变得更加复杂。
结论：这很可能是他最棒的一场大奖赛胜利，为这个强势的周末画上了句号。
- 虽然他的排位赛成绩从纸面上看很差，但尾翼直线模式的故障毁掉了冲刺排位赛，而在正式排位赛第一节中，车队指挥墙在交通管理上的一些失误也让他非常恼火。
- 从维修区发车后，他跑出了一场令人印象深刻的冲刺赛，一反常规地完成了几次超车动作。
- 正赛的表现堪称一流，他是唯一真正执行了一停策略的车手，在有干净空气时充分利用了优势，随后在比赛尾声阶段将皮埃尔·加斯利牢牢挡在安全距离之外。
- 唯一的负面因素是排位赛的情况以及比赛的进程，使得很难确切地衡量他的比赛节奏。但这并不是他的错。
结论：在一个不顺利的周末之后，他证明了自己仍然能够创造一场比赛奇迹。
- 他很好地适应了红牛赛车，从一开始的练习赛起，他就比2025年年初时显得轻松得多。
- 相对于马克斯·维斯塔潘，他展现出了不错的单圈速度，尤其是在正式排位赛中，他最终只慢了十分之一秒多一点。
- 大奖赛中获得第七名已经是能做到的最好成绩了，尽管没有维斯塔潘这个标杆来衡量。
- 本有望在冲刺赛排位赛中进入前十，却未能在第二节排位赛（SQ2）中跟上不断改善的抓地力。考虑到超车非常困难，这注定了他在冲刺赛中一分未得。
大奖赛本身很平淡，因为他的赛车没有足够的速度威胁前面的车手，但确实领先于中游集团。
黄旗违规处罚可能没有影响他的最终名次，但这本是一次不必要的处罚。
结论：考虑到他在周五之前从未驾驶过小红牛22，这已经达到了他所能期待的成绩上限。
- 与大幅升级的阿尔派（阿尔派）磨合良好，并在周末的冲刺环节表现出色，在排位赛和正赛中都拿到了可能取得的最好结果。
- 在因埃斯特班·奥康（奥康）引发虚拟安全车而重启比赛时，突袭了角田裕毅，将第11位转化为一个积分。
- 他在大奖赛中的比赛节奏不错，尽管一度被阿维德·林德布拉德（Arvid Lindblad）那辆如同移动路障的小红牛赛车所压制。
——周六第二节排位赛中没有把赛车的性能完全发挥出来，不过这主要是由于车队在交通管理方面出现了混乱。
- 相对弗朗哥·科拉平托的节奏优势没有意义，因为只有加斯利用上了升级套件。
结论：很好地适应了升级后的阿尔派。
- 将本周末冲刺赛环节中一切可能做到的事情发挥到了极致，从杆位起步并赢得胜利。
- 虽然他不一定是梅赛德斯车队中更快的那位车手，但就整个周末来看，他是表现更稳健的那一个。
- 在让过队友之后，他打了一场精彩的防守战，成功挡住汉密尔顿，保住了领奖台位置。
- 他本来有机会争夺大奖赛的杆位，但在11号弯用力过猛，导致轮胎温度飙升，这使他与诺里斯的较量形势急转直下。
- 他在发车时被安东内利超越，随后在重启时又被皮亚斯特里超越，这让他的夺冠机会大打折扣。
结论：在周末的冲刺赛部分表现出色，但在大奖赛中遇到了更多困难。
- 在冲刺赛中跑出了一场精彩的比赛，是仅有的两位使用软胎起头的车手之一，超越诺里斯后以第二名完赛。
- 他在不同轮胎配方下的比赛节奏都很好，并在大奖赛中完成了一次对皮亚斯特里的精彩超越。
- 第一次虚拟安全车（VSC）出现的时机对他在大奖赛中与汉密尔顿的较量不利，而他在那次较量中原本占据优势。
detailEn: Combine the sprint weekend format, the demands of the Zandvoort circuit, and rain just before the start - and the final edition of the Dutch Grand Prix (for the time being) had enough about it to properly test the Formula 1 field.
Who came out of that test unscathed and whose hopes were torpedoed? Here are Edd Straw's driver rankings from the Netherlands.
Champions-tier members can also try their hand at putting their own driver rankings together for Edd to react to in a separate feature!

How do the rankings work? The 22 drivers will be ranked in order of performance from best to worst on each grand prix weekend. This will be based on the full range of criteria, ranging from pace and racecraft to consistency and whether they made key mistakes. How close each driver got to delivering on the maximum performance potential of the car will be an essential consideration.

It’s important to note both that this reflects performance across the entire weekend, cognisant of the fact that qualifying is effectively ‘lap 0’ of the race and key to laying the foundations to the race, and that it is not a ranking of the all-round qualities of each driver. It’s simply about how they performed on a given weekend. Therefore, the ranking will fluctuate significantly from weekend to weekend.

And with each of the 11 cars fundamentally having different performance potential and ‘luck’ (ie factors outside of a driver’s control) contributing to the way the weekend plays out, this ranking will also differ significantly from the overall results.
- His stunning pace on the hard tyres, which team-mate Oscar Piastri couldn't switch on, was key to his victory.
- Razor-sharp in battle to take the opportunity to pass Kimi Antonelli when the pair were chasing the slower Lewis Hamilton.
- Was the faster McLaren driver even compared to Piastri's best work.
- Had a shot at sprint pole, but only produced what he called a "reasonable lap" to end up 0.041s behind George Russell.
- Slipped from second to third in the sprint, although in mitigation his pace after being passed showed the rear tyre degradation was a problem.
- Losing the lead at the restart from what he felt was the lower-grip pole position grid box after the red flag complicated his race.
Verdict: Probably his best grand prix win capped a strong weekend.

- While his qualifying performances looked poor on paper, the failure of straight mode in the rear wing ruined sprint qualifying, with some traffic-management errors from the pitwall infuriating him in Q1 proper.
- Drove an impressive sprint race after starting from the pits, going against convention by making some overtaking manoeuvres.
- Race drive was high-class, as he was the only driver to execute a de facto one-stopper and made the most of clear air when he had it, then kept Pierre Gasly at arm's length in the closing stages.
- The only negative is that qualifying circumstances and the way the races played out made it difficult to benchmark his pace definitively. But that's not his fault.
Verdict: Showed he could still produce a race miracle after a troubled weekend.
- Adapted well to the Red Bull and looked dramatically more comfortable than he did in early 2025 from the start of practice.
- Showed good single-lap pace relative to Max Verstappen, particularly in main qualifying as he ended up just over a tenth-of-a-second slower.
- Seventh in the grand prix was as good as it was going to get, albeit without the yardstick of Verstappen to measure it by.
- Was on target to make the top 10 in sprint qualifying, only to struggle to go with the improving grip in SQ2. Given how hard it was to pass, that doomed him to a pointless sprint.
- The grand prix itself was straightforward given he had a car that didn't have the pace to threaten those ahead, but was clear of the midfield.
- Yellow-flag infringement penalty may not have impacted his finishing position, but it was a needless penalty.
Verdict: At the upper limit of what he could have expected to achieve given he had never driven the RB22 before Friday.
- Gelled well with the heavily upgraded Alpine and excelled in the sprint parts of the weekend, getting the best-possible result in qualifying and the race.
- Ambushed Yuki Tsunoda at the restart from the Esteban Ocon-induced virtual safety car to turn 11th place into a point.
- Race pace was good in the grand prix, although he was contained for a spell by Arvid Lindblad's rolling-roadblock Racing Bulls.
- Didn't get the most out of the car in Q2 on Saturday, although that was largely down to the team's confused traffic management.
- Pace advantage over Franco Colapinto is meaningless given only Gasly had the upgrade.
Verdict: Adapted well to upgraded Alpine.
- Maximised what was possible in the sprint component of the weekend, winning from pole position.
- While he wasn't necessarily the faster Mercedes driver, taking the weekend as a whole he was the tidier one.
- Brilliant rearguard action to hold off Hamilton salvaged a podium, after letting through his team-mate.
- Had a shot at pole position for the grand prix, but overdid it into Turn 11 and spiked the tyre temperatures, which swung the battle with Norris against him.
- Lost out to Antonelli at the start, then Piastri at the restart, which meant his victory chances took a big hit.
Verdict: Outstanding in the sprint part of the weekend, but struggled a little more in the grand prix.
- Drove an excellent race in the sprint as one of only two drivers to start on softs, passing Norris to finish second.
- Race pace was good across compounds, and he made a good pass on Piastri in the grand prix.
- The timing of the first VSC went against him in the grand prix battle with Hamilton that he initially had the advantage in.

detailZh: 红牛对劳森在荷兰大奖赛的表现印象深刻：'他做到了他能做的'
Lawson在周末的荷兰大奖赛上顶替受伤的哈贾尔出战，并最大化发挥了他的红牛赛车性能
红牛一级方程式车队负责人Laurent Mekies对这位超级替补劳森印象深刻，因为他在荷兰大奖赛上发挥出了最大潜力。
这位24岁的车手在排位赛第八起步后最终排名第七，落后于三大强队——迈凯伦、梅赛德斯和法拉利，并且由于驾驶另一台小红牛22的维斯塔潘撞车而提升了一个名次。
这发生在一场更为艰难的冲刺赛之后，Lawson 在那场比赛中以第 11 位发车并以第 11 位完赛。这个周末，由于 哈贾尔 手腕受伤，他从 小红牛 临时转到了 红牛。
Mekies 告诉 天空体育：“如今要从一个车队跳槽到另一个车队实在太难了，所以我认为 Liam 已经做到了他能做的。”
“他显然在昨天的排位赛中做得非常出色，只比 Max 慢了十分之一秒，今天他基本上是一个人在比赛。”
“我们缺少 Max 这个参照，所以你知道的，对他的节奏不作评判，但他拿到了积分，拿到了第七名的积分，这大概就是他今天能做到的最好成绩了。”
尽管劳森在第55圈于3号弯因伊斯特班·奥孔在前一弯停车后，未能在单黄旗情况下减速而被罚10秒，他的成绩依然如此。
这位新西兰车手确认他会“从中吸取教训”，但考虑到他领先排名第八的尼科·霍肯伯格一整圈完成比赛，这对周日他在赞德沃特的比赛几乎没有影响。
“今天很艰难，说实话，”目前在车手积分榜排名第九的劳森告诉天空体育。
“第一圈相当有趣，但从那之后，说实话，我们的速度就跟不上前面那几位车手。”
“但我觉得经过昨天之后，我就知道这会是一场艰难的比赛，我们俩都落在他们后面，而且我觉得我昨天跑了一记相当不错的单圈，所以我早就知道会很难。
“可能没那么难，比如我们确实很难跟上前排的车队，但我确信自己能从中学到一些东西。周末结束后我显然会试着去理解一下。”
赞德沃特是Lawson自2025年初两次令人失望的比赛之后首次为红牛出战，目前尚不清楚他是否会回到姐妹车队小红牛参加接下来的蒙扎站。
detailEn: Red Bull impressed by Liam Lawson at Dutch GP: 'He did what he could'
Lawson replaced the injured Isack Hadjar at the Dutch Grand Prix over the weekend and maximised his Red Bull package
Red Bull’s Formula 1 boss Laurent Mekies was impressed by its super-sub Liam Lawson after he maximised what was possible at the Dutch Grand Prix.
The 24-year-old finished seventh behind the top three teams – McLaren, Mercedes and Ferrari – after starting eighth but gaining a place due to Max Verstappen’s crash in the sister RB22.
It came after a tougher sprint race where Lawson started and finished in 11th, on the weekend he temporarily moved from Racing Bulls to Red Bull due to Isack Hadjar’s wrist injury.
Mekies told Sky Sports: “It's so difficult nowadays to jump from a team to another, so I think Liam did what he could.
“He obviously did a very good job in qualifying yesterday being only a tenth away from Max, today was a bit of a race on his own.
“We are missing the reference from Max so, you know, no judgment on the pace but he took the points, he took the points of seventh place and that's probably the best he could have done today.”
Lawson’s result came despite him receiving a 10-second penalty for failing to slow down for a single yellow flag at Turn 3 on lap 55, after Esteban Ocon had stopped at the following corner.
The New Zealander confirmed he’ll “learn from that”, but considering he finished a lap ahead of eighth-placed Nico Hulkenberg, it made little difference to his race at Zandvoort on Sunday.
“Today was hard, honestly,” Lawson, who is ninth in the championship, told Sky Sports.
“The first lap was quite fun, but from then, honestly, we just struggled for pace to match the front guys.
“But I feel like after yesterday I knew it was going to be a hard race, we were both behind them and I feel like I did a pretty good lap yesterday, so I knew it was gonna be hard.
“Probably not that hard, like we really struggled to keep up with the front teams, but I'm sure there's stuff I can learn from. I'll obviously try and have an understanding after the weekend.”
Zandvoort was Lawson’s first race for Red Bull since his two disappointing outings at the start of 2025, and it is not yet clear if he will return to sister squad Racing Bulls for Monza up next.

items.summaryEn: Ferrari asked Charles Leclerc to pit twice on the same lap, but he chose not to, causing Lewis Hamilton to be held up longer than the team expected.
detailZh: 查尔斯·勒克莱尔在荷兰大奖赛上阻挡队友时，毫不怀疑法拉利希望他进站。
刘易斯·汉密尔顿在比赛中和赛后抱怨车队行动太慢，未能确保勒克莱尔在第40圈左右两人相遇时不阻挡他。然而勒克莱尔在同一圈内两次被告知进站，却未能执行。
车队原本希望在第41圈让勒克莱尔进站，但不想让他跟随乔治·拉塞尔的梅赛德斯进入维修区。法拉利告诉车手“反向”于拉塞尔进站，因此当梅赛德斯进站时，勒克莱尔遵循车队指令，也没有进站。
与此同时，汉密尔顿正在接近勒克莱尔，并担心队友会阻挡他。第42圈初，法拉利告诉勒克莱尔进站。
然而勒克莱尔对指令提出异议，告诉法拉利这会让他在拉塞尔面前处于劣势，后者已提前进站。经过一段沉默，时间足够勒克莱尔催促比赛工程师布莱恩·博齐回复，法拉利第二次指示车手进站。但勒克莱尔没有进站。
汉密尔顿越来越愤怒，告诉车队“我们只是在浪费时间。”在勒克莱尔最终在下一圈进站后，汉密尔顿讽刺地评论道：“太浪费时间了，伙计们，干得好。”
法拉利车手在拉塞尔之后完赛，汉密尔顿第四，领先勒克莱尔。
法拉利车队负责人弗雷德里克·瓦塞尔赛后声称，车队愿意接受汉密尔顿在比赛这个阶段损失一些时间，因为他们试图在不再次更换轮胎的情况下到达终点。
“关于刘易斯的情况是，我们一度试图坚持到终点，我认为那也会是个好决定，”他告诉天空体育。“我们可能和查尔斯损失了一秒。当你要坚持到终点时，目标不是这个，当然，考虑到之后发生的事情，你总是可以重新改写比赛。”
“反向于拉塞尔进站，反向于拉塞尔进站。”
“你什么意思？那会毁了我的比赛，我在拉塞尔之后两圈进站。”
勒克莱尔经过维修区入口但没有进站
“所以进站，查尔斯，进站，将换硬胎，加两格。”
detailEn: Charles Leclerc was in no doubt Ferrari wanted him to pit when he was holding his team mate up during the Dutch Grand Prix.

Lewis Hamilton complained during and after the race that the team acted too slowly to ensure Leclerc did not hold him up when the pair met on-track around lap 40. However Leclerc was told twice on the same lap to come in and failed to.

The team originally hoped to bring Leclerc in on lap 41 but did not want him to follow George Russell’s Mercedes into the pit lane. Ferrari told their driver to pit “opposite” Russell, so when the Mercedes came in Leclerc followed his team’s order and did not pit as well.
Meanwhile Hamilton was gaining on Leclerc and becoming concerned his team mate would hold him up. Early on lap 42 Ferrari told Leclerc to come in.

However Leclerc disputed the order, telling Ferrari it would put him at a disadvantage to Russell, who had pitted earlier. After a period of silence, which was long enough for Leclerc to prompt his race engineer Bryan Bozzi for a reply, Ferrari gave the driver a second instruction to pit. But Leclerc did not come in.

Hamilton was becoming increasingly infuriated, telling the team “we’re just losing time.” After Leclerc finally pitted on the next lap, following another instruction from Ferrari, Hamilton sarcastically commented: “Big waste of time guys, good job.”
The Ferrari drivers finished the race behind Russell, with Hamilton fourth ahead of Leclerc.

Ferrari team principal Frederic Vasseur claimed after the race the team was willing to accept Hamilton losing some time at this stage in the race as they were attempting to reach the chequered flag without changing his tyres again.

“The story with Lewis was that at one stage we were trying to go to the end and I think it would have been a good call, also,” he told Sky. “Probably we lost one second with Charles. The target when you go to the end, it’s not this one, and for sure with what’s happened after, you can always rewrite the race.”
Box opposite Russell, box opposite Russell.
What do you mean? That fucks my race, I stop two laps after Russell.
Leclerc passes the pit lane entrance without coming in
So box, Charles, box, will be for hard, plus two clicks.

items.summaryEn: Williams team principal James Vowles has declared that returning the Grove outfit to the required competitive level in Formula 1 will become his "life's journey".
detailZh: James Vowles称威廉姆斯 F1的重建是他的“人生之旅”
James Vowles表示，将威廉姆斯重建为具有竞争力的F1力量将成为他的“人生之旅”
威廉姆斯车队领队James Vowles宣称，让这支位于Grove的车队重新达到F1所需的竞争水平，将成为他的“人生之旅”。
Vowles于2023年加入威廉姆斯，面临着将过时的基础设施提升到标准的巨大挑战，并重建车队使其重返昔日夺冠时的辉煌。
在车队官方播客 Team Torque 中，Vowles 与 阿尔本 和 塞恩斯 一起，回顾了 威廉姆斯 正在进行的长期建设过程。
在回答一位车迷关于如何在 威廉姆斯 这样规模的团队中培养韧性和心理承受力的问题时，Vowles 说：“生活中有很多艰难的经历，但只要你以正确的方式去面对，你就能以一个更好的人从另一端走出来。”
“第二点是我固执且有毅力，我们一定会达到所需的水平。实现这一目标将成为我毕生的追求，但这同样也是你们两位（Albon 和 Sainz）的追求，而其背后的现实是，这会造就一种无人能摧毁的力量。”
威廉姆斯 的 2026 赛季开局艰难，他们带着一辆超重的赛车抵达巴林参加季前测试，并且错过了巴塞罗那的私人测试。但 Albon 和 Sainz 都在荷兰大奖赛之前签署了续约合同。
沃尔斯在播客中谈到了两位车手的承诺。他说：“感谢你们两位，明年能让你在我身边、成为威廉姆斯的一员，并希望未来许多许多年都如此，将是我的莫大荣幸。”
阿尔本已签约延长一年至2027年底，塞恩斯则签署了一份新的多年期合同。
detailEn: James Vowles calls Williams F1 rebuild his "life's journey"
James Vowles says rebuilding Williams into a competitive Formula 1 force will become his "life's journey"
Williams team principal James Vowles has declared that returning the Grove outfit to the required competitive level in Formula 1 will become his "life's journey".
Vowles joined Williams in 2023 and was faced with the immense challenge of bringing the outdated infrastructure up to scratch and rebuilding the team to return it to its championship-winning form.
Speaking on the team's official Team Torque podcast alongside Alex Albon and Carlos Sainz, Vowles reflected on the long-term building process underway at Williams.

Responding to a fan question about how to build resilience and mental toughness in a team the size of Williams, Vowles said: "There are so many life experiences that are hard that as long as you have the right approach to it, you come out the other side a better person.

"The second is that I am stubborn and persistent and we will be at the level we need to be. This will become my life's journey to achieve it, but as it is the both of yours [Albon and Sainz] as well, but the reality behind that is that it creates a strength that no one can break as a result of it."

Williams has had a tough start to its 2026 campaign, arriving at pre-season testing in Bahrain with an overweight car and having missed the private test at Barcelona. But both Albon and Sainz signed contract extensions ahead of the Dutch Grand Prix.

Vowles touched on the commitment from both drivers during the podcast. "Thank you to both of you, but it'll be an absolute honour to have you by my side and as part of Williams for next year and hopefully many, many years beyond," he said.
Albon has signed a one-year extension until the end of 2027 and Sainz has signed a new multi-year deal.

items.summaryEn: Audi Formula 1 driver Nico Hulkenberg says his "scary" incident with team-mate Gabriel Bortoleto at the start of the Dutch Grand Prix was a combination of luck and judgement, as the German avoided a disastrous accident.
detailZh: 霍肯伯格如何避免了与奥迪队友博托莱托的一次重大碰撞
霍肯伯格解释了在F1荷兰大奖赛发车时，他如何成功避免了撞上打转的奥迪队友博托莱托
奥迪F1车手霍肯伯格表示，他与队友博托莱托之间“吓人”的事故是运气与判断的结合，这位德国车手在荷兰大奖赛中避免了一场灾难性事故。
由于赞德沃特赛道在赛前阵雨后仍然潮湿，但已干到可以使用光头胎，维斯塔潘在第一圈结束时于最后一个带坡度的弯角发生了严重撞车。作为反应，Bortoleto的赛车来了一个360度旋转，最终停在赛道中央。
由于对向车流不得不采取避让动作，Bortoleto的奥迪队友Hulkenberg千钧一发之际险险避开了撞上这位巴西车手赛车侧面的危险，从其左侧绕了过去。
“太吓人了，很惊险，”松了一口气的Hulkenberg说道。“整条赛道都很干燥，只有那个弯角保持得非常湿滑，让很多车手中了招。那里非常难对付，我不确定他会往哪个方向走，是会往上滚还是往下滚。我一直在等待、犹豫，直到最后一刻。我们没撞上彼此真是有很大一部分运气成分，但那真的太惊险了。
“在那个速度下，我几乎是看着一切以慢动作发生的。我们之间只差一张纸的宽度，但也就仅此而已。
在维修区控制墙上，车队的比赛总监Allan McNish同时观看两个车载画面时也吓得心都提到了嗓子眼。
“我和他们每一秒都同在，这也是为什么我有时候白头发冒得特别快，”这位三届勒芒24小时耐力赛冠军打趣道。
“Max在他前面撞了车，而在那个特定时刻，那是赛道上难度远远最高的一个弯角。不过只有在回放中，才非常明显地看出我们两辆车的距离有多近。
“当我最初看到Gabriel打转、然后Nico从另一边出来时，我并没有立刻意识到他冲进了烟雾里。所以，对我来说，那一刻真有点像《壮志凌云》（Days of Thunder）的情节，心脏有点受不了……”
Allan McNish，奥迪F1车队竞赛总监
作为一名前车手剖析这起事故时，McNish说：“当你前方发生状况时，有一个心理过程，但也有一种本能。本能地知道该往哪里去、该做什么。有些人具备这种能力，有些人则没有。
“在那之后，还有从本能到判断的过渡。你要避让到什么程度？往哪个方向？斜坡弯墙是另一回事，这也是为什么Gabi能够做到让车保持在赛道中间、没有侧滑撞上护墙，让我印象非常深刻。
“不知道那是本能，还是技术和专注力，或是其他什么。但那绝对是一次漂亮的救车！
Hulkenberg最终以第八名拿到四个积分，这标志着奥迪连续第四个比赛周末都有积分入账，而Bortoleto则远远落后，仅列第13位。
detailEn: How Nico Hulkenberg avoided a massive shunt with Audi team-mate Gabriel Bortoleto
Nico Hulkenberg explains how he managed to avoid crashing into his spinning Audi team-mate Gabriel Bortoleto at the start of F1's Dutch Grand Prix

Audi Formula 1 driver Nico Hulkenberg says his "scary" incident with team-mate Gabriel Bortoleto was a combination of luck and judgement as the German avoided a disastrous accident in the Dutch Grand Prix.

With the Zandvoort circuit still damp from a pre-race shower but dry enough for slick tyres, Max Verstappen suffered a heavy crash at the end of lap one in the final, banked corner. In reaction Bortoleto went through a 360-degree spin as his car became stationary in the middle of the track.

As oncoming traffic had to take avoiding action, Bortoleto's Audi team-mate Hulkenberg was somehow narrowly able to avoid spearing into the side of the Brazilian's car, swerving around the left-hand side.

"It was scary, sketchy," a relieved Hulkenberg reported. "The whole track was very dry, just that corner stayed much wetter and caught people out. It was very tricky and I wasn't sure where he was going to go, if he was going to roll up or roll down. I was waiting, hesitating until the last moment. A good portion of luck not to hit each other there, but that was too close for comfort.
"I saw it happen almost in slow motion at that speed. A sheet of paper would have fit between us, but not much more."
From the pitwall, the team's racing director Allan McNish also had his heart in his mouth as he watched both onboards simultaneously.
"I live every second with them, which is why I'm turning grey very quickly at times," the three-time Le Mans 24 Hours winner quipped.

"Max shunted in front of him, and it was the trickiest corner on the circuit by a long way at that particular point. But it was only on the replay where it was quite evident how close it was between our two cars.
"When I first saw Gabriel spinning and then Nico coming out the other side of it, I didn't quite realise that he had gone into the smoke. So, it was a bit too much Days of Thunder for my heart..."
Allan McNish, Racing Director, Audi F1 Team

Dissecting the incident as a former racer, McNish said: "When something's happening ahead of you, there is a mental process, but there's also an instinct. It's instinctive knowing where to go and what to do. Some people have got it and some people don't.

"And then after that, there's an element of instinct to judgement. How far do you go? In which direction? A banking is a different thing, which is why I was very impressed with what Gabi was able to do to keep it in the middle of the circuit and for it not to spoon up into the wall.
"Whether it was instinct or skill and focus or anything else, I don't know. But it was a bloody good save!"
Hulkenberg went on to take four points in eighth, marking Audi's fourth consecutive points-scoring weekend, while Bortoleto finished a distant 13th.

items.summaryEn: Alex Brundle believes Lewis Hamilton was fully justified in venting his frustration over team radio during the Dutch Grand Prix. The seven-time champion finished fourth at Zandvoort, narrowly missing out on a podium.
detailZh: 阿历克斯·布伦德尔表示，刘易斯·汉密尔顿在紧张的荷兰大奖赛车队无线电通话中“完全有理”。
阿历克斯·布伦德尔为刘易斯·汉密尔顿在荷兰大奖赛期间通过车队无线电表达沮丧情绪的做法进行了辩护。
阿历克斯·布伦德尔认为，刘易斯·汉密尔顿在荷兰大奖赛期间通过车队无线电发泄失望情绪是完全有道理的。
这位七届世界冠军在赞德沃特与领奖台失之交臂，最终以第四名冲过终点线，落后于比赛冠军兰多·诺里斯以及梅赛德斯车队的基米·安东内利和乔治·拉塞尔。
汉密尔顿在整个比赛中显然都很沮丧，通过无线电传出了多条气氛紧张的通讯。在F1 TV复盘比赛时，布伦德尔为汉密尔顿的发火进行了辩护，当时维修墙询问他想换哪种轮胎配方。
“如果我坐在车里也会被惹恼，因为车队居然在问你想换什么轮胎，”布伦德尔解释道。“他们已经看过夏尔勒·勒克莱尔用中性胎跑过一节了。他们手里掌握着全部数据，而实际上维修墙上的工程师却在根据车手会说的话来左右摇摆、规避责任。”
“当然，刘易斯参加了简报会，刘易斯感受过轮胎，他是唯一坐在车里的人。但我认为他那次的回应，其实发生在一个有些波动的日子，那天他通过无线电的整体语气听起来确实有点烦躁。”
“我认为他对那一件事的回应是完全合理的。他嗅到了争夺总冠军的机会，不是吗，刘易斯·汉密尔顿？他知道，以梅赛德斯今年迄今为止展现出的速度，再加上在蒙扎这样、以及即将到来的巴库这样的赛道的速度，就像迈凯伦一样，所有环节都必须做到完美无误。”
“如果他想拿下第八个冠军，他就不得不设法让自己占据更有利的位置。这就是这场比赛中那种激烈程度的来源。他在这个周末开始时说过，我花了大部分暑假时间进行训练，以便以最好的状态去冲击这个总冠军，而结果却令人沮丧。”
detailEn: Lewis Hamilton "entirely justified" in tense Dutch GP radio exchange, says Alex Brundle
Alex Brundle has defended Lewis Hamilton’s frustrated Dutch Grand Prix radio messages
Alex Brundle believes Lewis Hamilton was fully justified in venting his frustration over team radio during the Dutch Grand Prix.

The seven-time champion narrowly missed out on a podium at Zandvoort, taking the chequered flag in fourth place behind race winner Lando Norris and the Mercedes pair of Kimi Antonelli and George Russell.

Hamilton was clearly frustrated throughout the race with various tense radio messages. While reviewing the race on F1 TV, Brundle defended Hamilton's outburst when the pitwall asked which tyre compound he wanted to change to.

"That would upset me from inside the car as well because you're looking at the team asking you which tyre you want to be put on," Brundle explained. "They've already seen a stint on the medium compound from Charles Leclerc. They're sitting there with all of the data, and effectively you've got an engineer on the pitwall hedging their bets based around what the driver is going to say.

"Of course Lewis has sat in the briefings. Lewis has felt the tyres. He's the only person sitting in the car. But I think his response there actually came amid a slightly turbulent day where he did sound slightly upset over the radio in general.

"I think his response to that particular one was entirely justified. He's got a sniff of a championship, hasn't he, Lewis Hamilton? And he knows that with the pace of the Mercedes as it's been so far this year, and with the pace of them at a circuit like Monza, like Baku coming up, just like with McLaren, everything's going to have to be right.
